data.one_liner: Displays a highly customizable week or day view widget to show scrollable and zoomable events.
data.what_it_does: Provides DayView and WeekView widgets that render calendar events on a customizable time grid. It supports scrolling, zooming, drag-and-drop, event resizing, and various styling configurations.
use_when: You need to display a calendar or schedule with day and week views.
You require features like event zooming, scrolling, drag-and-drop, and resizing.
avoid_when: You only need a standard month-view calendar without detailed hourly time slots.
You want a fully packaged full-screen calendar solution with integrated reminders or complex recurring event engines.
strengths: Highly customizable views, styles, and builders.
Supports drag-and-drop and event resizing out of the box.
Supports multi-platform including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Focused primarily on day/week grid layouts rather than month or agenda views.
Custom event handling requires specific mixins or subclasses.
